name: docs-slides
description: Turn a brief into a real PowerPoint deck (.pptx) or a compiled document (.docx/.pdf) you can open and send. Write the brief as ordinary markdown — '## ' per slide for a deck, headings and lists for a document — and the document writers PersonalClaw already ships render the file. Nothing leaves your machine and nothing is written outside this app's own data directory.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Brief size cap
x-meta.help: Largest brief, in characters, this app will render. A brief past the cap is refused with the number rather than rendered into a file nothing can open.
